rules.doc: Food used on oneself is eaten: it feeds hunger (Minecraft: health comes back from being well fed, not from the bite). Used on another who gets hungry, it feeds them; on anything else it is undefined (a wolf offered meat: the AI answers).

Using a thing on something its nature says nothing about: the bare body used on anything is a blow (Minecraft's fist), and so is anything swung; on a place of the overworld it is out of reach; on a creature it is held out to it (the creature answers: offered, design.md §5.2). On anything else it is the player's experiment: undefined (the AI answers).

rules.doc: A hand on a person: a quest they have for you, else what fits the moment, and their talk opens (§2.9). Asked (a talk verb): news, to follow, to wait, persuaded, bribed, threatened, an apology, what was taken given back, stopped by the watch; a word no rule knows is theirs to answer (the AI's).
